About Me

{/* Left: your bio */}

I’m a Running Start student at SPSCC pursuing an A.A. in Computer Science and an aspiring Electrical & Computer Engineer. Over the past three years, I’ve led robotics teams, founded STEM outreach programs, and developed web applications during the Headstarter AI Fellowship.

As captain of FRC Team 4450, I restructured leadership and ran rookie workshops; as founder of FIRST STEP ORG, I launched six FLL teams and mentored over 60 students; and through my fellowship, I mastered HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Git workflows.
